handshake-mss-floor/mss535.synack.reason: wgstack.md, TCP の機能, MSS, and packet-validation.md, TCP の MSS の下限: the ingress drops SYNs with an MSS of 1 to 535

limited-transmit/first-dupack.new-data.reason: wgstack-performance.md, RACK-TLP: wgstack always runs RACK, and at the testbench's near-zero RTT its reorder window is about zero, so it resends the first segment at the first SACK instead of sending new data; limited-transmit-rack checks Limited Transmit on a path with an RTT

limited-transmit/no-retransmit-before-th.reason: wgstack-performance.md, RACK-TLP: RACK, always on, resends the first segment before any duplicate-ACK threshold

limited-transmit/second-dupack.new-data.reason: as limited-transmit/first-dupack.new-data: RACK has already resent the first segment

rfc2525-stretch-ack-burst-ooo/dupack-per.reason: wgstack-rs.md, per-wake ACK merging: eight out-of-order segments injected before the poll get one duplicate ACK, not one each as RFC 5681 3.2 asks. Measured: 1 duplicate ACK for 8 segments

rfc2525-stretch-ack-burst/every-second-s.observed: an ACK covers more than two segments; all acknowledged
rfc2525-stretch-ack-burst/every-second-s.reason: wgstack-rs.md, per-wake ACK merging: the core makes at most one content-free ACK per connection per wake, so a burst of twelve segments injected before the poll gets one ACK over all twelve, past the every-second-segment SHOULD of RFC 5681 4.2. Measured: 1 ACK for 12 segments
